title: pteris pseudocaudata
intro: Pteris pseudocaudata, commonly known as the Rough-leaved Brake fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. It is an evergreen, perennial plant native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia and Australia. The Rough-leaved Brake fern has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects.
